label: Sudd inundated area incl. flooded vegetation (MODIS)
aggregation: sum of inundated pixel area (observed + carried + climatology probability), day-weighted monthly mean of 8-day composites
notes: Sudd counties only (16). Per 8-day MOD09A1 composite, QA-clear pixels (state flags + blue<0.2) are classed OPEN WATER if MNDWI(b4,b6)>0 and INUNDATED if open water or EVI-LSWI<=0.05 (Xiao et al. 2006 / Sakamoto et al. 2007 flooding signal; captures water under papyrus/grass that MNDWI misses). Cloudy pixels take their last clear state if <=3 composites (24 days) old, else the 2018-2025 probability of inundation for that composite-of-year. Monthly = day-weighted mean of the 8-day areas. Sep-Oct 2022 partly from MCD43A4 NBAR (Terra tiles missing on PC). 2025-07..2025-11 missing (no MODIS on PC). Validation: docs/VALIDATION_sudd_water.md.
source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD09A1 v061 8-day 500 m surface reflectance via Microsoft Planetary Computer

label: Cloud-free share (Sudd water layer)
aggregation: day-weighted mean share of county pixels observed clear in the 8-day composites
notes: Quality flag: share of the value that is directly observed (the rest is gap-filled). Low Jun-Oct.
source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD09A1 v061 8-day 500 m surface reflectance via Microsoft Planetary Computer

label: Climatology-filled share (Sudd water layer)
aggregation: day-weighted mean share of county pixels filled from the 2018-2025 composite climatology
notes: Quality flag: pixels cloudy for >24 days, filled with their 2018-2025 inundation probability for that time of year; high values pull the month toward the climatological mean.
source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD09A1 v061 8-day 500 m surface reflectance via Microsoft Planetary Computer
